subjects.title: ZIA Firewall Control
subjects.lead: Configuring Firewall policies requires the Firewall Filtering, NAT Control and DNS Control policies, as applicable, and each has its own rules.

subjects.title: Firewall rule actions
subjects.lead: A Firewall Filtering rule's action is one of ALLOW, BLOCK_DROP, BLOCK_RESET, BLOCK_ICMP or EVAL_NWAPP.

subjects.title: Firewall Filtering rule criteria

subjects.title: IP destination groups
subjects.lead: A destination group's type is one of DSTN_IP, DSTN_FQDN, DSTN_DOMAIN or DSTN_OTHER.

subjects.title: IPS Control
subjects.lead: IPS Control uses signature-based detection over all ports and protocols, with signatures built and updated by Zscaler's security research team plus signature...

subjects.title: Which firewall features need Advanced Firewall
subjects.lead: Configuring and applying firewall policies based on users, groups, departments or network applications requires Advanced Firewall.

subjects.title: Firewall rule, criteria and group limits
subjects.lead: Firewall Filtering is capped at 1,021 rules with Advanced Firewall and 10 on the standard tier.

subjects.title: Firewall rule order, admin rank and predefined rules
subjects.lead: IPS Control rules are evaluated in ascending numerical order of their rule order (Rule 1 before Rule 2).

subjects.title: Where the firewall sits in the traffic path
subjects.lead: All web traffic is evaluated in the firewall module first, and only traffic that does not violate a firewall policy is forwarded to the web module.
